title: Releases workspace: recorded context, exact reviews and deliberate execution
goal: Identify current Releases context and deliberate next control while separating draft/intake, recorded readiness, exact independent review, one-attempt provider execution and outcome reconciliation.
prerequisites: Internal source-only local-preview draft, not customer-approved content. Current selected workspace/session and exact per-control service enablement/authority must be independently checked.
Mounted DeploymentRequestsView, not dormant ReleasesView. Historical cards/backend routes alone do not establish mounted/available current actions.
Independent review must be genuine and personal under a different eligible current identity. No impersonation/automatic checkbox or requester-as-independent substitution.
permissions: Scope/ownership/recorded PR approval/readiness checkboxes are recorded assertions, not independent provider/deployment approval.
Current authority/version/window/digest/source/target/Governance checks decide each consequential action; Governance incomplete/unavailable cannot be inferred accepted from this article.
Simulation, provider merge and deployment approvals remain separate decisions. Approval records review, not execution; requester/designated executor separately requests exact current action once.
Artifact/profile/read-only observations do not grant cloud/provider/CI authority. No actual enrollment, runtime flag access, provider success, shipped activation or accepted provisioning is claimed.
